name: one side archer push up
description: A push up where one arm does most of the work while the other extends out to the side. It builds unilateral chest and arm strength.
instructions: Start in a wide push up position with hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one arm and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up and shift to the centre.
Alternate or complete reps on one side, then switch.
